basis: Visually read the complete PU map and exception windows, the 22-driver usage baseline, all three new-elements pages, five distinct PU-sanction decisions, all 18 substantive upgrade pages and Pirelli V3. Doc 38 is no further action; Doc 42's qualifying deleted laps remain in the full penalty reader; Doc 44 found no action on the 2:00.0 Safety-Car-line times; Doc 45 fined the team €5,000 for Lindblad's unsafe release; Doc 46 permitted Bearman to start. On 23 November, visually read FIA Race Director Document 21 (19 November, 22:02): the instruction is below 2:00.0 between the Safety Car lines on any lap during and after qualifying and on race-reconnaissance laps while pit exit is open; added the exact session scope and source to Circuit and Notes.
